verdict.rationale: Pulley's help center serves a working llms.txt file (HTTP 200) listing agent-oriented doc links, and several docs pages are available in .md format, showing genuine agent-friendly documentation. However, the probe for a docs-md wildcard 404s, no OpenAPI/agent spec is discoverable, and there's no explicit vendor messaging about supporting AI agents. missing for 10: broader confirmation that all docs pages are consistently .md-accessible, an official statement encouraging agent use, and API/schema discoverability for agents.
